sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里，人们发现了一具女性遗体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 最终，侦探们查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但她的身份确认，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的最新作品，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: At around 3am on Sunday August 19, 1990, 35-year-old Rudy Manuel was awoken by a strange sound.
sentences.zh: 1990年8月19日，星期日，凌晨3点左右，35岁的鲁迪·曼努埃尔被一阵奇怪的声音惊醒。

sentences.en: As the long-time caretaker of the Camp Nelson Lodge, a 42-acre bucolic retreat in Central
sentences.zh: 作为尼尔森营旅馆的长期看管人，鲁迪对这片位于加州中部、占地42英亩、

sentences.en: California's sprawling and isolated sequoia and redwood forests, Rudy was intuitively familiar with his surroundings.
sentences.zh: 坐落在广袤而偏僻的红杉林中的田园式度假地，有着直觉般的熟悉感。

sentences.en: When horses in a nearby pasture began stirring restlessly in the middle of the night, Rudy sensed something, or someone, was out there.
sentences.zh: 当附近牧场的马匹在深夜不安地躁动时，鲁迪感觉到外面有什么东西，或者什么人。

sentences.en: Rudy opened the door of the rustic cabin where he had been sleeping and looked outside.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪打开了他睡觉的那间乡村小屋的门，向外望去。

sentences.en: If something was lurking, Rudy couldn't see it through the pitch-black darkness.
sentences.zh: 如果真有什么东西潜伏在外面，鲁迪在漆黑的夜色中也无法看清。

sentences.en: He closed the door and locked it, turned off the lights, and crawled back into bed.
sentences.zh: 他关上门并锁好，关掉灯，爬回了床上。

sentences.en: Rudy wasn't alone.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪并不是一个人。

sentences.en: Lying next to him was 46-year-old Bonnie Hood, the owner and manager of the Camp Nelson Lodge.
sentences.zh: 躺在他身边的，是46岁的邦妮·胡德，尼尔森营旅馆的老板兼经理。

sentences.en: Five minutes later, the bedroom light suddenly turned on.
sentences.zh: 五分钟后，卧室的灯突然亮了。

sentences.en: It took a moment for Rudy's eyes to adjust and for him to realise that an unfamiliar person was standing over him.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪花了一会儿才适应光线，并意识到一个陌生人正站在他上方。

sentences.en: The intruder was aiming a snub-nosed .38-caliber revolver directly at Rudy's head.
sentences.zh: 入侵者正用一把短管.38口径左轮手枪直指鲁迪的头部。

sentences.en: The man ordered Rudy to get off the bed and kneel on the floor.
sentences.zh: 那人命令鲁迪下床，跪在地上。

sentences.en: Rudy defiantly responded,
sentences.zh: 鲁迪反抗道：

sentences.en: If you want me on the floor, you're going to have to put me down.
sentences.zh: “如果你想让我跪下，你就得先开枪打死我。”

sentences.en: Without hesitation, the gunman pulled the trigger, shooting Rudy in the forehead.
sentences.zh: 枪手毫不犹豫地扣动了扳机，击中了鲁迪的前额。

sentences.en: As Rudy's body slumped to the ground, the gunman turned his attention to Bonnie Hood, demanding,
sentences.zh: 当鲁迪的身体瘫倒在地时，枪手将注意力转向了邦妮·胡德，逼问道：

sentences.en: Where's the money?
sentences.zh: “钱在哪里？”

sentences.en: Bonnie replied in a panic,
sentences.zh: 邦妮惊慌失措地回答：

sentences.en: It's in the lodge.
sentences.zh: “在旅馆里。”

sentences.en: Bonnie was then shot as she cowered in bed.
sentences.zh: 随后，蜷缩在床上的邦妮也被枪杀。

sentences.en: Even though the bullet had pierced Rudy Manuel's skull and left fragments in his brain, he was still alive.
sentences.zh: 尽管子弹穿透了鲁迪·曼努埃尔的头骨，并在他的大脑中留下了碎片，但他依然活着。

sentences.en: Blood ran down his face, his ears rang painfully, and the taste of gunpowder lingered in his mouth.
sentences.zh: 鲜血顺着他的脸流下，耳中嗡嗡作响，嘴里还残留着火药的味道。

sentences.en: Rudy pretended to be dead until the gunman left.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪假装死亡，直到枪手离开。

sentences.en: He then slowly crawled across the floor into the living area where he reached for a telephone.
sentences.zh: 随后，他缓慢地爬过地板，来到起居区，伸手去拿电话。

sentences.en: Using what little strength Rudy had left, he dialed 911.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪用尽最后一点力气，拨打了911。

sentences.en: The history of the Camp Nelson Township dates back to 1886, when its founder, John Nelson, built a homestead on the land.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森营镇的历史可以追溯到1886年，当时创始人约翰·尼尔森在这片土地上建立了一个家园。

sentences.en: Before long, his ranch became a popular destination for hunters, fishermen, and anyone else willing to make the journey into the mountains by horseback.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他的牧场成了猎人、渔民以及任何愿意骑马进山的人的热门目的地。

sentences.en: By the early 20th century, Camp Nelson had grown into a thriving, albeit small, community with a hotel and a general store that drew an influx of new visitors to the area.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪初，尼尔森营已发展成一个繁荣但规模不大的社区，拥有一家酒店和一家杂货店，吸引了大量新游客。

sentences.en: Bonnie Hood first visited Camp Nelson in 1952, when she was eight years old.
sentences.zh: 邦妮·胡德在1952年八岁时第一次来到尼尔森营。

sentences.en: By then, the centrepiece of the town was a massive stone and timber lodge built by John Nelson's grandson.
sentences.zh: 那时，镇上的核心建筑是由约翰·尼尔森的孙子建造的一座巨大的石木结构旅馆。

sentences.en: Featuring a grand dining hall and an impressive great room with two enormous fireplaces,
sentences.zh: 旅馆拥有宏伟的餐厅和带两个巨大壁炉的壮观大厅，

sentences.en: the magnificent Camp Nelson Lodge served as the town's de facto community centre for almost every important event.
sentences.zh: 这座宏伟的尼尔森营旅馆几乎是镇上举办所有重要活动的实际社区中心。

sentences.en: Bonnie and her family visited Camp Nelson every summer, and she carried on the tradition when she started a family of her own.
sentences.zh: 邦妮和她的家人每年夏天都会来尼尔森营，当她组建自己的家庭后，也延续了这个传统。

sentences.en: However, as time went on, the lodge was plagued by financial woes leading to its closure in January 1981.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着时间的推移，旅馆陷入了财务困境，并于1981年1月关闭。

sentences.en: In the summer of 1987, Bonnie and her husband Jim noticed a for sale sign out in front of the lodge.
sentences.zh: 1987年夏天，邦妮和丈夫吉姆注意到旅馆前挂着一块出售的牌子。

sentences.en: While the couple initially joked with each other about buying the property, they ultimately decided to make a serious offer.
sentences.zh: 虽然这对夫妇最初只是开玩笑说要买下这处房产，但最终他们决定认真报价。

sentences.en: Their offer of $780,000 was accepted, and by June 1988, Bonnie and Jim Hood were the new owners of the Camp Nelson Lodge.
sentences.zh: 他们78万美元的报价被接受了，到1988年6月，邦妮和吉姆·胡德成为了尼尔森营旅馆的新主人。

sentences.en: Even though Bonnie had been visiting the area since she was a child, many of the town's 180 residents viewed the lodge's new owners with scepticism.
sentences.zh: 尽管邦妮从小就经常来这里，但镇上180名居民中的许多人对旅馆的新主人持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: To them, the hoods were outsiders – wealthy metropolitan interlopers who threatened to change the fabric of their community.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，胡德一家是外来者——是威胁要改变社区结构的富有大都市闯入者。

sentences.en: Others were excited by the prospect of the lodge being restored to its former glory.
sentences.zh: 也有人对旅馆恢复昔日辉煌的前景感到兴奋。

sentences.en: In order to revive and operate the lodge full-time,
sentences.zh: 为了全面恢复和经营旅馆，

sentences.en: Bonnie relocated to Camp Nelson and moved into one of the cabins.
sentences.zh: 邦妮搬到了尼尔森营，住进了其中一间小屋。

sentences.en: Her husband Jim and their two teenage children remained at their home in Newport Beach, nearly four and a half hours' drive away.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫吉姆和两个十几岁的孩子留在了纽波特比奇的家中，那里距离这里有近四个半小时的车程。

sentences.en: The unconventional arrangement drew judgement among townsfolk, as did some of Bonnie's other decisions.
sentences.zh: 这种非传统的安排引起了镇民的议论，邦妮的其他一些决定也是如此。

sentences.en: While the locals were initially thrilled when the lodge's restaurant and bar reopened, they were dismayed when Bonnie raised the prices.
sentences.zh: 虽然当地人最初对旅馆餐厅和酒吧的重新开业感到兴奋，但当邦妮提高价格时，他们感到非常不满。

sentences.en: Others boycotted the establishment altogether when Bonnie kicked them out for being too rowdy.
sentences.zh: 当邦妮因为一些人太吵闹而将他们赶出去时，其他人干脆抵制了这家店。

sentences.en: When Bonnie built fences for her horses, some of her neighbours complained they blocked access to their properties.
sentences.zh: 当邦妮为她的马建造围栏时，一些邻居抱怨这些围栏阻碍了他们进入自己的房产。

sentences.en: She also caused a stir for being an outspoken environmentalist, working to expose what she believed were illegal logging practices in the area.
sentences.zh: 她还因为直言不讳的环保主义立场而引起了轰动，致力于揭露她认为该地区存在的非法伐木行为。

sentences.en: As one employee who worked for Bonnie told the Fresno Bee,
sentences.zh: 正如邦妮的一名员工告诉《弗雷斯诺蜜蜂报》的那样：

sentences.en: Bonnie answered to no one and apologised to no one.
sentences.zh: “邦妮不听命于任何人，也不向任何人道歉。”

sentences.en: But what upset locals most was Bonnie's plan to turn the lodge into a trendy venue for lavish destination weddings and a high-end luxury retreat
sentences.zh: 但最让当地人不满的是，邦妮计划将旅馆改造成一个时尚的场所，用于举办奢华的目的地婚礼，并打造一个高端度假胜地，

sentences.en: catering to wealthy clientele from Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 专门接待来自洛杉矶的富有客户。

sentences.en: In their view, the whole point of going to Camp Nelson was to get away from the fast-paced city lifestyle in the first place.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，去尼尔森营的全部意义就在于远离快节奏的城市生活。

sentences.en: While some felt Bonnie harboured a combative LA attitude that conflicted with Camp Nelson's breezy, carefree way of life, others were less critical of her.
sentences.zh: 虽然有些人觉得邦妮带有与尼尔森营轻松自在的生活方式相冲突的洛杉矶式好斗态度，但也有人对她的批评较少。

sentences.en: One local told the Fresno Bee that the majority view of Bonnie was that she was a cheerful, outgoing person who spent an enormous amount of time, money and energy
sentences.zh: 一位当地人告诉《弗雷斯诺蜜蜂报》，大多数人认为邦妮是一个开朗、外向的人，她投入了大量的时间、金钱和精力，

sentences.en: bringing Camp Nelson Lodge back to life.
sentences.zh: 让尼尔森营旅馆重获新生。

sentences.en: On Saturday August 18, 1990, a high society wedding and reception was held at the lodge.
sentences.zh: 1990年8月18日，星期六，一场上流社会的婚礼和招待会在旅馆举行。

sentences.en: The bride was thrilled with the venue and wept tears of joy while complimenting Bonnie on how wonderful everything had been.
sentences.zh: 新娘对场地非常满意，流下了喜悦的泪水，并称赞邦妮把一切都安排得如此美妙。

sentences.en: It was welcomed reinforcement that Bonnie's vision for the lodge was coming to fruition.
sentences.zh: 这是一种受欢迎的肯定，证明邦妮对旅馆的愿景正在实现。

sentences.en: While the wedding was taking place at the lodge, its restaurant and bar remained open to the public, making it far busier than a regular Saturday night.
sentences.zh: 婚礼在旅馆举行期间，其餐厅和酒吧仍对公众开放，这使得它比普通的周六晚上要繁忙得多。

sentences.en: When live music started during the wedding reception, some locals at the bar joined in the festivities.
sentences.zh: 当婚礼招待会开始现场音乐表演时，酒吧里的一些当地人也加入了庆祝活动。

sentences.en: The reception concluded just before midnight, but the bar stayed open, serving locals until 2am.
sentences.zh: 招待会在午夜前结束，但酒吧一直营业，为当地人服务到凌晨2点。

sentences.en: At the end of the evening,
sentences.zh: 当天晚上结束时，

sentences.en: Bonnie pulled all the tips her waitstaff had collected during their shifts.
sentences.zh: 邦妮收走了服务员在轮班期间收到的所有小费。

sentences.en: Usually, she split the tips evenly before sending her staff home.
sentences.zh: 通常，她会在让员工回家前平分这些小费。

sentences.en: But because there was much more money than usual, approximately $500, she decided to take the money back to her cabin.
sentences.zh: 但由于金额比平时多得多，大约有500美元，她决定把钱带回自己的小屋。

sentences.en: She promised to count it and pay out her employees the next morning.
sentences.zh: 她承诺第二天早上会清点并支付给员工。

sentences.en: Just over an hour later, first responders arrived at Bonnie's cabin after receiving the 911 call from Rudy Manuel.
sentences.zh: 一个多小时后，在接到鲁迪·曼努埃尔的911报警电话后，急救人员赶到了邦妮的小屋。

sentences.en: They trepidatiously entered and turned on the lights.
sentences.zh: 他们小心翼翼地进入并打开了灯。

sentences.en: They immediately saw Rudy's body on the floor of the living room, covered in carpet burns and blood.
sentences.zh: 他们立刻看到鲁迪的身体躺在起居室的地板上，身上满是地毯摩擦伤和血迹。

sentences.en: He had been shot in the head.
sentences.zh: 他的头部中弹了。

sentences.en: A trail of blood led from where Rudy lay and into the bedroom, ending by the bed.
sentences.zh: 一条血迹从鲁迪躺着的地方一直延伸到卧室，在床边结束。

sentences.en: Laying on top, half covered by a blanket and sheet, was Bonnie Hood.
sentences.zh: 躺在床上，被毯子和床单半遮盖着的，是邦妮·胡德。

sentences.en: She had been fatally shot in the head.
sentences.zh: 她的头部中弹身亡。

sentences.en: It appeared her body had been posed afterwards, with her arms crossed over her chest as if she were laid in a casket.
sentences.zh: 她的遗体似乎在事后被摆放过，双臂交叉在胸前，就像躺在棺材里一样。

sentences.en: One of the screens on an exterior sliding door had been cut open.
sentences.zh: 外部的一扇推拉门上的纱窗被割开了。

sentences.en: The same door featured pry marks, indicating the killer had used a tool to force his way inside.
sentences.zh: 同一扇门上有撬痕，表明凶手使用了工具强行闯入。

sentences.en: In the dirt outside was a single shoe print left by the killer.
sentences.zh: 外面的泥地上留下了凶手的一枚鞋印。

sentences.en: Aside from this, the only other major clue was found inside the cabin.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，唯一的其他重要线索是在小屋内发现的。

sentences.en: As Rudy Manuel had clung to life, he used his finger to scrawl two letters on a wall in his own blood.
sentences.zh: 当鲁迪·曼努埃尔在垂死挣扎时，他用手指在墙上用自己的血写下了两个字母。

sentences.en: J and B.
sentences.zh: J和B。

sentences.en: Police were well aware of a near two-decade-long feud between Rudy Manuel and a local cattle rancher named Jack Burgess.
sentences.zh: 警方非常清楚鲁迪·曼努埃尔与当地牧场主杰克·伯吉斯之间长达近二十年的积怨。

sentences.en: Rudy was a Native American who had grown up on a reservation a few miles south of Camp Nelson.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪是一名美洲原住民，在尼尔森营以南几英里处的一个保留地长大。

sentences.en: From the time he was a teenager,
sentences.zh: 从十几岁起，

sentences.en: Rudy had been a thorn in Jack Burgess's side.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪就一直是杰克·伯吉斯的眼中钉。

sentences.en: His cattle ranch bordered the reservation and Jack had accused Rudy of vandalising his property many times over the years.
sentences.zh: 他的养牛场与保留地接壤，多年来，杰克多次指控鲁迪破坏他的财产。

sentences.en: He also once accused Rudy of shooting at him.
sentences.zh: 他还曾指控鲁迪向他开枪。

sentences.en: Rudy had a checkered history with convictions for horse-stealing, vandalism, and assault.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪有前科，曾因偷马、破坏公物和袭击他人而被定罪。

sentences.en: Struggling to find employment or a place to live,
sentences.zh: 在难以找到工作或住所的情况下，

sentences.en: Rudy was given an opportunity to work for Bonnie Hood after she purchased the Camp Nelson Lodge in 1988.
sentences.zh: 1988年邦妮·胡德买下尼尔森营旅馆后，给了鲁迪一个工作的机会。

sentences.en: The following year,
sentences.zh: 第二年，

sentences.en: Rudy was arrested after trying to sell five of Jack Burgess's calves to another rancher.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪因试图将杰克·伯吉斯的五头小牛卖给另一位牧场主而被捕。

sentences.en: Facing a potential six-month jail sentence,
sentences.zh: 面临可能长达六个月的监禁，

sentences.en: Rudy found a supporter in Bonnie Hood.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪在邦妮·胡德那里找到了支持。

sentences.en: She paid for his defence attorney and the case against Rudy was ultimately dismissed.
sentences.zh: 她为他支付了辩护律师费用，针对鲁迪的案件最终被驳回。

sentences.en: This angered Jack Burgess, who expressed his opinion that the police and judge were corrupt.
sentences.zh: 这激怒了杰克·伯吉斯，他表达了自己的观点，认为警察和法官都是腐败的。

sentences.en: Things only escalated when Rudy smashed the windshield of Jack's truck with a baseball bat.
sentences.zh: 当鲁迪用棒球棍砸碎杰克卡车的挡风玻璃时，事态进一步升级。

sentences.en: On Tuesday June 19, 1990, exactly two months before the shooting,
sentences.zh: 1990年6月19日，星期二，也就是枪击案发生前整整两个月，

sentences.en: Rudy suffered an appendicitis attack.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪患上了阑尾炎。

sentences.en: Bonnie drove him to the hospital, and as she pulled into the parking lot, she noticed that Jack Burgess happened to be there too.
sentences.zh: 邦妮开车送他去医院，当她驶入停车场时，她注意到杰克·伯吉斯也恰好在那里。

sentences.en: Not paying him any mind, she took Rudy into the emergency department.
sentences.zh: 她没理会他，带着鲁迪进了急诊室。

sentences.en: Upon returning to her car,
sentences.zh: 回到车上时，

sentences.en: Bonnie noticed a handwritten note attached to her windshield.
sentences.zh: 邦妮注意到挡风玻璃上贴着一张手写的纸条。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着：

sentences.en: It is your head, not your windshield, that I will get.
sentences.zh: “我要对付的是你的头，而不是你的挡风玻璃。”

sentences.en: Payback's a bitch, like your sugar mama.
sentences.zh: “报应真爽，就像你的糖妈一样。”

sentences.en: Bonnie believed that Jack Burgess had left the note for Rudy.
sentences.zh: 邦妮认为杰克·伯吉斯是留给鲁迪的这张纸条。

sentences.en: She suspected she was the sugar mama referenced in the note as she had previously paid for Rudy's attorney during his successful legal stoush against Jack.
sentences.zh: 她怀疑自己就是纸条中提到的“糖妈”，因为她之前曾为鲁迪支付过律师费，帮助他在与杰克的法律纠纷中获胜。

sentences.en: Bonnie filed a police report accusing Jack of authoring the note.

sentences.en: He even sought the advice of a paralegal who confirmed this to be the case.
sentences.zh: 他甚至咨询了一位律师助理，对方证实确实如此。

sentences.en: Emboldened by this knowledge and motivated to profit on his story,
sentences.zh: 在这一认知的鼓舞下，为了从自己的故事中获利，

sentences.en: Bruce consulted a freelance author about writing a tell-all book about what really happened in Camp Nelson.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯咨询了一位自由撰稿人，打算写一本关于尼尔森营（Camp Nelson）真相的揭秘书。

sentences.en: He knew that such a revelation would not only ruin Jim Hood's business and reputation, but likely result in Jim being arrested for Bonnie's murder.
sentences.zh: 他知道，这样的揭露不仅会毁掉吉姆·胡德的事业和名声，还很可能导致吉姆因邦妮的谋杀案被捕。

sentences.en: Bruce used this as leverage to squeeze more money out of Jim.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯以此为筹码，试图从吉姆那里榨取更多钱财。

sentences.en: He bombarded him with threatening calls, trying to extort and blackmail him.
sentences.zh: 他不断打威胁电话骚扰吉姆，试图勒索和敲诈他。

sentences.en: He demanded that Jim make a wire transfer to his bank account, but Jim was reluctant to leave a paper trail.
sentences.zh: 他要求吉姆将钱电汇到他的银行账户，但吉姆不愿留下纸质记录。

sentences.en: Instead, Jim told Bruce to meet him at his office to settle the matter there.
sentences.zh: 相反，吉姆告诉布鲁斯到他的办公室见面，在那里解决问题。

sentences.en: In the lead-up to the meeting, Bruce didn't know what to expect.
sentences.zh: 在会面之前，布鲁斯不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: He told his wife Sharon,
sentences.zh: 他告诉妻子莎伦：

sentences.en: Jim either wants to kill me, set me up to get arrested, or pay me off.
sentences.zh: “吉姆要么想杀了我，要么想设局让我被捕，要么就是想花钱打发我。”

sentences.en: Sharon's story was corroborated by her brother, Gary Spray, who was involved in Bruce's campaign against Jim Hood.
sentences.zh: 莎伦的说法得到了她哥哥加里·斯普雷的证实，他参与了布鲁斯针对吉姆·胡德的行动。

sentences.en: Gary added that Jim had initially agreed to pay Bruce $250,000.
sentences.zh: 加里补充说，吉姆最初同意支付给布鲁斯250,000美元。

sentences.en: The $50,000 Bruce had already received was the first of what was supposed to be a series of installments paid out by Jim every six months.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯已经收到的50,000美元是吉姆承诺每六个月支付的一系列分期付款中的第一笔。

sentences.en: It was when Jim failed to pay Bruce as promised that Bruce and Gary hatched their plan to steal the construction equipment from him.
sentences.zh: 正是因为吉姆没有按承诺付款，布鲁斯和加里才策划了从他那里窃取建筑设备的计划。

sentences.en: Investigators knew Sharon and Gary
sentences.zh: 调查人员知道莎伦和加里·

sentences.en: Spray's testimonies amounted to little more than hearsay and might not even be admissible in court.
sentences.zh: 斯普雷的证词充其量只是传闻，甚至可能无法在法庭上采信。

sentences.en: Given their criminal history and drug use, a jury would also be less inclined to consider them credible witnesses.
sentences.zh: 考虑到他们的犯罪记录和吸毒史，陪审团也不太可能认为他们是可信的证人。

sentences.en: Instead, they worked to uncover more evidence of their claims, starting with a solid motive.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们努力挖掘更多证据来支持他们的说法，首先从一个扎实的动机入手。

sentences.en: The obvious one was Bonnie's alleged affair with the Rudy Manual.
sentences.zh: 最明显的动机是邦妮与鲁迪·曼努埃尔所谓的婚外情。

sentences.en: Residents of Camp Nelson referred to the relationship as the worst-kept secret in town, but investigators could only find one witness who claimed to have actually
sentences.zh: 尼尔森营的居民称这段关系是镇上公开的秘密，但调查人员只能找到一名证人声称曾亲眼

sentences.en: seen the pair acting intimately.
sentences.zh: 看到两人举止亲密。

sentences.en: A bartender from the lodge said he'd seen
sentences.zh: 旅馆的一名酒保说他曾有一次看到

sentences.en: Bonnie and Rudy kiss on one occasion, hardly enough evidence to prove a long-standing sexual affair.
sentences.zh: 邦妮和鲁迪接吻，但这很难作为证明长期婚外情的充分证据。

sentences.en: While Rudy had initially admitted to the affair, he'd changed his story at Bruce's trial and denied it ever happened.
sentences.zh: 虽然鲁迪最初承认了这段婚外情，但在布鲁斯的审判中他改变了说法，否认此事发生过。

sentences.en: If he changed his story again, it would mean admitting that he'd committed perjury in a murder trial.
sentences.zh: 如果他再次改变供词，就等于承认自己在谋杀案审判中做了伪证。

sentences.en: Although the truth about the affair remained up for debate, there was evidence that Jim and Bonnie's marriage marriage was on the rocks.
sentences.zh: 尽管关于这段婚外情的真相仍有争议，但有证据表明吉姆和邦妮的婚姻已经岌岌可危。

sentences.en: Several people close to Bonnie claimed that she'd talked openly about divorcing
sentences.zh: 几位与邦妮关系密切的人称，她曾公开谈论过要与

sentences.en: Jim in the days prior to her murder.
sentences.zh: 吉姆离婚，就在她遇害前的几天里。

sentences.en: According to Bonnie's bookkeeper,
sentences.zh: 据邦妮的记账员说，

sentences.en: Bonnie had scheduled an appointment with a divorce attorney on Monday,
sentences.zh: 邦妮预约了一位离婚律师，时间定在周一，

sentences.en: August 20, 1990, the night before she was killed.
sentences.zh: 即1990年8月20日，也就是她遇害的前一天晚上。

sentences.en: Financial gain was another potential motive.
sentences.zh: 经济利益是另一个潜在动机。

sentences.en: Jim had always maintained that the lodge was breaking even financially.
sentences.zh: 吉姆一直坚称旅馆在财务上处于收支平衡状态。

sentences.en: But a review of his tax records showed that the business had lost $550,000 between 1989 and 1990.
sentences.zh: 但对其税务记录的审查显示，该业务在1989年至1990年间亏损了55万美元。

sentences.en: Jim was also found to have been deliberately overstating the value of his various real estate holdings.
sentences.zh: 人们还发现，吉姆一直在蓄意夸大他名下各类房地产的价值。

sentences.en: Although he claimed to be a multimillionaire, in reality, he was in a precarious financial position.
sentences.zh: 尽管他自称是千万富翁，但实际上他的财务状况岌岌可危。

sentences.en: Not long after purchasing the lodge,
sentences.zh: 在买下旅馆后不久，

sentences.en: Bonnie Hood had received a $250,000 inheritance.
sentences.zh: 邦妮·胡德就收到了一笔25万美元的遗产。

sentences.en: The money would have gone a long way in covering the lodge's expenses, but
sentences.zh: 这笔钱本可以很大程度上覆盖旅馆的开支，但

sentences.en: Bonnie refused to put her own money into the business.
sentences.zh: 邦妮拒绝将自己的钱投入到这项业务中。

sentences.en: Rumours had it that this became a major source of contention between the hoods.
sentences.zh: 有传言称，这成了胡德夫妇之间主要的争执来源。

sentences.en: In the aftermath of Bonnie's murder, Jim was the beneficiary of her $750,000 life insurance policy.
sentences.zh: 在邦妮遇害后，吉姆成为了她75万美元人寿保险的受益人。

sentences.en: It turned out that he'd also collected an additional $2 million from a separate mortgage insurance policy that he'd taken out on the lodge, bringing his entire
sentences.zh: 事实证明，他还从另一份他为旅馆投保的抵押贷款保险中额外获得了200万美元，使他因

sentences.en: windfall from Bonnie's death to nearly $3 million.
sentences.zh: 邦妮之死而获得的全部横财接近300万美元。

sentences.en: With all of this information coming to light, investigators were certain of their long-standing theory that Jim Hood had hired a hitman to kill his wife.
sentences.zh: 随着所有这些信息浮出水面，调查人员确信他们长期以来的推论：吉姆·胡德雇佣了杀手来杀害他的妻子。

sentences.en: Further digging revealed that Bruce
sentences.zh: 进一步挖掘发现，布鲁斯·

sentences.en: Beecham had previously proven himself willing and able to do Jim's dirty work.
sentences.zh: 比彻姆此前已证明自己愿意并有能力为吉姆干脏活。

sentences.en: In 1989, Jim had apparently paid Bruce
sentences.zh: 1989年，吉姆显然支付给布鲁斯

sentences.en: $9,000 to illegally cut down 35 trees to give passing motorists a better view of a
sentences.zh: 9000美元，非法砍伐了35棵树，以便让过往司机能更好地看到

sentences.en: Mission Plaza billboard.
sentences.zh: 任务广场的广告牌。

sentences.en: The hitman theory formed the basis of the prosecution's case against Jim Hood when he went to trial in October 1992.
sentences.zh: 杀手理论构成了1992年10月吉姆·胡德受审时检方指控的基础。

sentences.en: Although Jim maintained that he'd killed
sentences.zh: 尽管吉姆坚称他是出于自卫才杀死了

sentences.en: Bruce Beecham in self-defence, the prosecution argued that he'd murdered Bruce to bring an end to his extortion efforts.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯·比彻姆，但检方辩称他是为了终结布鲁斯的勒索行为而将其谋杀。

sentences.en: The problem was, investigators hadn't been able to find tangible proof that Bruce had received any money from Jim Hood, aside from his old paychecks from work.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，除了布鲁斯以前的工作工资单外，调查人员一直没能找到布鲁斯从吉姆·胡德那里收到任何钱的实质性证据。

sentences.en: The defence accused Sharon and Gary Spray of making their story up so they could file a lawsuit against Jim for Bruce's wrongful death.
sentences.zh: 辩方指责莎伦和加里·斯普雷编造故事，以便他们能就布鲁斯的非正常死亡对吉姆提起诉讼。

sentences.en: Although Sharon denied this accusation on the stand, it was revealed that she had already consulted with three separate lawyers about filing such a lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 尽管莎伦在证人席上否认了这一指控，但据披露，她此前已经就提起此类诉讼咨询过三位不同的律师。

sentences.en: Jim Hood took the stand in his own defence.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·胡德亲自出庭为自己辩护。

sentences.en: He claimed not to know whether Bruce was involved in
sentences.zh: 他声称不知道布鲁斯是否卷入了

sentences.en: Bonnie's murder and asserted that any bad blood between the two men stemmed from the theft of his construction equipment and the subsequent prosecution of Gary Spray.
sentences.zh: 邦妮的谋杀案，并断言两人之间的积怨源于他的建筑设备被盗以及随后对加里·斯普雷的起诉。

sentences.en: Jim maintained that he'd invited Bruce to his office to settle their differences peacefully and only gunned Bruce down when Bruce went to shoot him firSt.
sentences.zh: 吉姆坚称他邀请布鲁斯到办公室是为了和平解决分歧，只有在布鲁斯先开枪时，他才开枪射杀了布鲁斯。

sentences.en: It took the jury 20 days to announce that they'd reached a verdict, only to change their mind the following morning and continue deliberations.
sentences.zh: 陪审团花了20天才宣布达成裁决，结果第二天早上又改变了主意，继续进行审议。

sentences.en: In the end, they were at an impasse.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: Ten jurors had settled on guilty verdicts, one believed Jim wasn't guilty and the remaining juror was undecided.
sentences.zh: 十名陪审员认定有罪，一名认为吉姆无罪，剩下的一名陪审员尚未决定。

sentences.en: A mistrial was declared, with a retrial scheduled for later in the year.
sentences.zh: 法庭宣布审判无效，重审定于今年晚些时候进行。

sentences.en: Jim Hood's retrial commenced in September 1993, with the surprising revelation from the judge.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·胡德的重审于1993年9月开始，法官带来了一个令人惊讶的披露。

sentences.en: He barred the prosecution from presenting any evidence suggesting that Jim had hired Bruce Beecham to murder his wife, making it clear that
sentences.zh: 他禁止检方提出任何暗示吉姆雇佣布鲁斯·比彻姆谋杀其妻子的证据，并明确表示

sentences.en: this trial would focus solely on Bruce's murder and not on the murder of
sentences.zh: 这次审判将仅关注布鲁斯的谋杀案，而不是

sentences.en: Bonnie Hood.
sentences.zh: 邦妮·胡德的谋杀案。

sentences.en: The prosecution therefore had no choice but to centre their case around the physical evidence from the crime scene in Jim's office.
sentences.zh: 因此，检方别无选择，只能将案件重心放在吉姆办公室犯罪现场的物证上。

sentences.en: As for the motive, they could only go so far as to assert that Bruce was attempting to blackmail Jim about something.
sentences.zh: 至于动机，他们只能断言布鲁斯试图就某事勒索吉姆。

sentences.en: Jim had already admitted during the first trial that he'd paid Bruce to do illegal work for him in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 吉姆在第一次审判中已经承认，他过去曾付钱给布鲁斯让他做非法工作。

sentences.en: This alone proved that Bruce was in possession of some knowledge that he could use against Jim.
sentences.zh: 仅此一点就证明布鲁斯掌握了一些可以用来对付吉姆的信息。

sentences.en: Jim Hood took the stand again, but he changed several critical details from his original testimony.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·胡德再次出庭，但他改变了最初证词中的几个关键细节。

sentences.en: In the first trial, Jim claimed that Bruce's hand and head had moved in very specific ways after he'd been shot.
sentences.zh: 在第一次审判中，吉姆声称布鲁斯中枪后，他的手和头有非常具体的动作。

sentences.en: During the retrial, however, Jim denied that Bruce had moved at all.
sentences.zh: 然而在重审期间，吉姆否认布鲁斯有任何动作。

sentences.en: In order to show the jury that Jim had changed his story, the prosecution did something they believed had never been done in a California courtroom.
sentences.zh: 为了向陪审团展示吉姆改变了供词，检方做了一件他们认为在加州法庭上从未做过的事。

sentences.en: They called jurors from the first trial to testify as eyewitnesses to what Jim's original testimony had been.
sentences.zh: 他们传唤了第一次审判的陪审员出庭，作为吉姆最初证词内容的目击证人。

sentences.en: One by one, the former jurors provided irrefutable proof that Jim had perjured himself on the stand, completely shattering his credibility.
sentences.zh: 前陪审员们逐一提供了无可辩驳的证据，证明吉姆在证人席上做了伪证，彻底摧毁了他的可信度。

sentences.en: After six days of deliberation, the second jury returned a unanimous verdict.
sentences.zh: 经过六天的审议，第二个陪审团做出了全体一致的裁决。

sentences.en: Jim Hood was found guilty of murdering Bruce Beecham and sentenced to 29 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·胡德被判谋杀布鲁斯·比彻姆罪名成立，被判处29年监禁。

sentences.en: Jim continued to maintain his innocence in the murders of both Bruce and Bonnie.
sentences.zh: 吉姆继续坚称自己在布鲁斯和邦妮的谋杀案中都是无辜的。

sentences.en: His two children stood by him, believing he was wrongfully convicted and falsely accused for both crimes.
sentences.zh: 他的两个孩子支持他，认为他被冤枉了，两项罪名都是被诬告的。

sentences.en: In 2012, Jim's ongoing claims of innocence cost him the opportunity to be released from prison early due to good behaviour.
sentences.zh: 2012年，吉姆坚持声称自己无罪，使他失去了因表现良好而提前出狱的机会。

sentences.en: He was considered a model inmate, having taken courses in stress management and conflict resolution.
sentences.zh: 他被认为是一名模范囚犯，参加了压力管理和冲突解决课程。

sentences.en: According to prison officials, Jim never once violated a single prison rule.
sentences.zh: 据监狱官员称，吉姆从未违反过任何一条监狱规定。

sentences.en: However, in the words of the state governor,
sentences.zh: 然而，用州长的话说，

sentences.en: The governor's statements demonstrated the catch-22 of prisoners who claimed to be truly innocent.
sentences.zh: 州长的声明揭示了那些声称自己真正无辜的囚犯所面临的“第22条军规”困境。

sentences.en: Jim's refusal to confess meant he remained in prison for a further five years.
sentences.zh: 吉姆拒绝认罪，意味着他必须在监狱里多待五年。

sentences.en: He was ultimately released in 2017 after serving 23 years and has since kept a low profile.
sentences.zh: 他在服刑23年后最终于2017年获释，此后一直保持低调。

sentences.en: Authorities remain convinced that Bruce Beecham killed Bonnie Hood under Jim's order.
sentences.zh: 当局仍然确信布鲁斯·比彻姆是在吉姆的指使下杀害了邦妮·胡德。

sentences.en: In 1996, Bonnie's case was reopened after police received a package claiming to contain new information about her murder.
sentences.zh: 1996年，在警方收到一个声称包含有关邦妮谋杀案新信息的包裹后，她的案件被重新开启。

sentences.en: What the package contained, or who sent it, has never been made public.
sentences.zh: 包裹里装了什么，或者是谁寄出的，从未向公众披露。

sentences.en: Upon further investigation, the sheriff determined the new information wasn't enough to officially close the case.
sentences.zh: 经进一步调查，警长确定这些新信息不足以正式结案。

sentences.en: As of 2024, the murder of Bonnie Hood officially remains unsolved.
sentences.zh: 截至2024年，邦妮·胡德的谋杀案在官方记录中仍未侦破。
